profiles.biography: Michael Lentz is a color guard and visual adjudicator and designer and a 2025 Winter Guard International Hall of Fame inductee. He co-founded Onyx in 1988, a three-time WGI World Champion independent guard based in Dayton, Ohio, and has designed for world and open class drum corps, DCA, indoor winds, high school marching bands, and WGI, serving as Artistic Director for the Boston Crusaders' 2014 production and later leading the Troopers' color guard. He has adjudicated for Bands of America and Drum Corps International, including the Color Guard caption at DCI World Championships.

profiles.biography: Tim Landess is a color guard and visual adjudicator who began judging in 2003 and became a WGI judge in 2007. A member of the Florida Federation of Judges, he has judged winter guard and marching band contests nationwide (including for Bands of America since 2003) and was a visual designer and color guard director for winter guards and marching bands across Indiana for nearly two decades. He served as the Color Guard judge at the 2022 DCI World Championship Semifinals.

profiles.biography: Bob Thomas, of Apollo, Pennsylvania, is a visual adjudicator and educator who has taught many championship high school marching bands, drum and bugle corps, winter guards, and winter winds. He judges or has judged for Bands of America, Drum Corps International, Winter Guard International, Drum Corps Midwest, Drum Corps Atlantic, ISSMA, Drum Corps Europe, the Atlantic Indoor Association, and others, and designed the current scoring system used by Drum Corps Europe and Drum Corps Asia across 12 countries. He is Chairman of Drum Corps Asia, Director of Education for the Atlantic Indoor Association, Co-Chair of the PIMBA Education Committee, and Director of Education for the Virginia Marching Band Cooperative.

profiles.biography: Chris Hestin is a general-effect and percussion adjudicator whose passion for the activity began as a member of the Phantom Regiment. He was appointed Percussion Coordinator and arranger for the Spirit drum and bugle corps and previously served as Percussion Caption Head and arranger for the Glassmen. He has served in the General Effect captions at DCI World Championships and is an active WGI percussion adjudicator and the Percussion Judge Training Director for both the Mid-East Judges Association (Dayton, OH) and the Florida Federation of Colorguards Circuit, also judging for Bands of America and the Pennsylvania Federation of Contest Judges.

profiles.biography: Gregory 'Greg' Llacer is a general-effect, visual, and color guard adjudicator and clinician who has judged field show, winter guard, and percussion competitions nationwide since 1989. He adjudicates for Bands of America Regional, Super Regional, and Grand National Championships, Drum Corps International regular season and World Championships, and WGI Winds Regional and World Championships. He has been Chief Judge of the Texas Color Guard Circuit for twelve years, serves as WGASC's Color Guard Chief Judge, and is the Judge Training Coordinator for CWEA, designing and delivering training materials for the judging community.

_research.captionFingerprint: General Effect 1 / Color Guard / Visual Proficiency / Visual Analysis; 2013-2025

facts.fact: Adjudicator since 1989; TCGC Chief Judge 12 yrs; WGASC Color Guard Chief Judge; CWEA Judge Training Coordinator; DCI/BOA/WGI judge

profiles.biography: Charles 'Charley' Poole Jr. is a Hall of Fame percussion adjudicator, arranger, and educator who has taught, arranged for, and adjudicated marching bands, drum corps, and percussion ensembles across the United States, Canada, and Japan. He serves as the DCI Atlantic Division percussion caption chairperson and was unanimously elected to the DCI Task Force on Judging as the percussion instructor representative (1980-1986). He arranged for and instructed the 27th Lancers of Revere, Massachusetts (1977-1986) and East Coast Jazz (2005 DCI Division II Champions), and is a member of the World Drum Corps, Drum Corps International, and Massachusetts Drum Corps Halls of Fame.

profiles.biography: Beverly Brahan, of Jackson, Mississippi, is a color guard and general-effect adjudicator with over 25 years as a national visual and color guard judge for both field and indoor marching arts. She has been a General Effect and Color Guard judge for Drum Corps International since 2022 and serves on the DCI Judge Administration Team as the Visual Facilitator for DCI's Judge Diversity Initiative.

He designs for marching bands across Wisconsin, Michigan, Illinois, and Iowa, is the chief judge for the Wisconsin School Music Association, and adjudicates for Drum Corps International, Winter Guard International, and Bands of America.

profiles.biography: Meghan McCourt is a general-effect and color guard adjudicator, choreographer, and instructor who began as a dancer and color guard performer and pursued undergraduate studies in Dance Education at George Mason University. An alumna of the Dominion Winter Guard and the Carolina Crown drum and bugle corps, she has choreographed and instructed for marching band, winter guard, cheerleading, and show choir programs, and works in Human Resources with Madison Square Garden Entertainment in New York. She is an adjudicator for Winter Guard International, Bands of America, and Drum Corps International, serving in the General Effect caption at DCI World Championships.
